name: plug_preset
title: Plug preset
changes: Fills in all six plug numbers from a measured reference plug, so the pocket, the wall notch, the cord hook and the zip-tie and wing positions all take that plug's shape at once.

name: measure_plug_length
title: Plug length
changes: Runs the pocket farther toward the finger holes and stretches the whole body to keep the finger holes and zip-tie rows clear of it.

name: measure_plug_width_prong_end
title: Plug width at the prong end
changes: Widens or narrows the pocket, its seat and the wall notch at the plug end, and moves the zip-tie holes and wing openings with them.

name: measure_plug_width_cord_end
title: Plug width at the cord end
changes: Tilts the pocket's side walls to match the plug's taper, and the zip-tie holes and wing openings lean in with them.

name: measure_plug_thickness_prong_end
title: Plug thickness at the prong end
changes: Deepens or shallows the two pocket floors, the round seat and the plug recess, to suit the fatter of the two thickness numbers.
note: The fatter of the two thickness numbers sets the floors, so lowering one alone changes nothing; 24 mm or more sends you to the two-sided puller.

name: measure_plug_thickness_cord_end
title: Plug thickness at the cord end
changes: Deepens or shallows the two pocket floors, the round seat and the plug recess, when this end is the fatter end of the plug.
note: The fatter of the two thickness numbers sets the floors, so lowering one alone changes nothing; 24 mm or more sends you to the two-sided puller.

name: measure_cord_thickness
title: Cord thickness
changes: Widens the cord hook's slot and crossbar to fit the cord, and moves the finger holes and the whole body up to make room.

name: measure_wall_plate_style
title: Outlet cover plate style
changes: Cuts the wall notch at the plug end deeper or shallower to suit the cover plate, and the zip-tie rows shift down with it.

name: show_plug_preview
title: Show the see-through plug
changes: Shows or hides the see-through plug in the preview and changes nothing in the printed tool.
note: Changes no shape: the see-through plug is a preview aid and is never exported.

name: size
title: Hand size
changes: Scales the whole body, both finger holes, the wing openings and the zip-tie grid to the chosen hand size.

name: measure_finger_width
title: Finger width
changes: Widens both finger holes, spaces them farther apart and pushes them and the body up to keep the walls printable.
note: Only acts when size is Measure my hand.

name: measure_hand_width
title: Hand width
changes: Widens the whole body outline and thickens the slab in step with the hand.
note: Only acts when size is Measure my hand.

name: attachment
title: Attachment
changes: Adds or removes the zip-tie holes and the wing or slot openings for the strap.

name: velcro_style
title: Strap opening style
changes: Swaps the curved wing openings for a pair of plain rectangular slots that lean along the body's sides.

name: strap_width
title: Strap width
changes: Sets the strap width the wing opening is checked against and changes no shape.
note: Changes no shape: it only sets the width the W-14 check compares the wing opening against.

name: hook_hand
title: Hook side
changes: Mirrors the cord hook at the cord end so its catch faces the other side, and nothing else moves.

name: zip_placement
title: Zip-tie hole placement
changes: Switches the zip-tie pairs from the automatic rows to the three position dials, which slide each pair along the plug's side.

name: zip_row_count
title: Number of zip-tie rows
changes: Adds or removes a pair of zip-tie holes, and the rows squeeze together when the body has no room for another.

name: zip_pos_1
title: Zip-tie pair 1 position
changes: Slides the first pair of zip-tie holes along the plug's side, measured from the plug end.
note: Only acts when zip_placement is Manual.

name: zip_pos_2
title: Zip-tie pair 2 position
changes: Slides the second pair of zip-tie holes along the plug's side, measured from the plug end.
note: Only acts when zip_placement is Manual.

name: zip_pos_3
title: Zip-tie pair 3 position
changes: Slides the third pair of zip-tie holes along the plug's side, measured from the plug end.
note: Only acts when zip_placement is Manual and zip_row_count is 3.

name: zip_edge_offset
title: Zip-tie hole distance from the pocket wall
changes: Moves every zip-tie hole farther from or closer to the pocket wall, and the wing openings reshape around them.

name: velcro_placement
title: Strap slot placement
changes: Switches the strap openings to a pair of plain slots that the position dial slides along the plug's side, whatever the opening style.

name: velcro_pos
title: Strap slot position
changes: Slides the pair of strap slots along the plug's side, measured from the plug end.
note: Only acts when velcro_placement is Manual.

name: quality
title: Render quality
changes: Sets how many flat segments draw each curve and changes no dimension.
note: Changes no shape: it only sets the number of segments in every circle and arc.

name: reset_custom_to_medium
title: Reset Custom to the Medium reference
changes: Swaps every Custom slider for the Medium reference values for one render, so the whole tool snaps back to the Medium shape.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_enable_auto_fit
title: Auto-fit
changes: Lets the tool clamp any Custom slider that would push a feature past the body or into a neighbor, and changes nothing while every slider is inside its safe range.
note: Changes no shape at the Custom defaults: it only clamps sliders that leave their safe range, and every clamp is reported in the console.

name: custom_puller_length
title: Body length
changes: Stretches the whole body from the cord end to the plug end.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_puller_bottom_width
title: Body width at the widest point
changes: Widens the body at its widest point, just above the cord end, before the side rounding is applied.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_puller_bottom_corners
title: Cord-end corner width
changes: Widens the flat at the cord end where the two lower corners of the body outline sit.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_puller_top_width
title: Body width at the plug end
changes: Widens the plug end of the body, where the wall notch and the pocket seat sit.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_puller_middle_width
title: Body width at the middle
changes: Widens the body at the middle control point, bulging or straightening the side edges between the widest point and the plug end.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_puller_side_corner
title: Side corner position
changes: Moves the two widest corners of the body outline up toward the plug end or down toward the cord end.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_body_thickness
title: Body thickness
changes: Thickens the whole slab, so every hole and the pocket get deeper walls.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_body_round_bottom_only
title: Round the cord half only
changes: Rounds the whole outline instead of only the cord half, so the plug end loses its crisp corners.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_pocket_seat_diameter
title: Pocket seat diameter
changes: Widens the round seat cut into the plug end of the pocket.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_pocket_width
title: Pocket width
changes: Widens the plug recess, and the zip-tie holes and wing openings move outward with its wall.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_pocket_depth
title: Pocket depth
changes: Runs the plug recess farther from the plug end toward the finger holes.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_pocket_dome_drop
title: Pocket reference drop
changes: Changes no shape of the pocket, because the recess outline is built from the plug width at the plug end and the side taper, and this reference point cancels out of it.
note: Changes no shape: the recess is a rounded-nose shape whose width at the plug end is the pocket width and whose walls follow the side taper, so this reference point cancels out; measured with straight and with tapered walls.

name: custom_pocket_seat_floor
title: Pocket seat floor thickness
changes: Thins or thickens the floor left under the round seat, so the seat is cut deeper or shallower.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_pocket_floor
title: Plug recess floor thickness
changes: Thins or thickens the floor left under the plug recess, so the recess is cut deeper or shallower.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_pocket_side_angle
title: Pocket side taper
changes: Tilts the pocket's side walls inward toward the cord end, and the zip-tie holes and strap slots lean in along the same line.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_enable_finger_holes
title: Finger holes on or off
changes: Cuts or leaves out both finger holes.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_finger_hole_diameter
title: Finger hole diameter
changes: Widens both finger holes.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_finger_hole_spacing
title: Finger hole spacing
changes: Moves the two finger holes farther apart or closer together.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_finger_hole_y_position
title: Finger hole position
changes: Slides both finger holes up toward the pocket or down toward the cord hook.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_enable_t_hook
title: Cord hook on or off
changes: Cuts or leaves out the cord hook at the cord end.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_t_hook_base_gap
title: Hook slot width
changes: Widens the slot the cord slides into at the cord end.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_t_hook_length
title: Hook length
changes: Runs the cord hook farther into the body from the cord end.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_t_hook_holder_width
title: Hook crossbar width
changes: Widens the crossbar the cord hooks under at the top of the slot.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_t_hook_holder_length
title: Hook crossbar height
changes: Makes the crossbar opening taller or shorter along the body.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_t_hook_gap_offset
title: Hook slot inset
changes: Changes no shape of the printed tool, because the J-hook cord catch does not read this dial.
note: Changes no shape: the J-hook cord catch is drawn without this dial; it only appears in the Cutouts Only 2D debug overlay.

name: custom_t_hook_leg_offset
title: Hook stem side offset
changes: Moves nothing on the hook itself, and only pushes the finger holes up when the auto-fit keep-out around the hook grows with it.
note: Only acts when size is Custom; the J-hook cord catch is drawn without this dial, and only the auto-fit clamp on the finger holes reads it.

name: custom_t_hook_stem_offset
title: Hook stem offset
changes: Shifts the cord slot sideways along the crossbar, making the J of the hook deeper or shallower.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_t_hook_catch_reach
title: Hook catch reach
changes: Extends the crossbar past the slot on the catch side, lengthening the lip the cord hooks under.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_t_hook_tip_drop
title: Hook tip drop
changes: Sags the slot's mouth farther below the cord end so a hooked cord cannot back out.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_enable_plug_wall_notch
title: Wall notch on or off
changes: Cuts or leaves out the notch at the plug end that straddles the outlet's cover plate.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_plug_wall_notch_width
title: Wall notch width
changes: Widens or narrows the notch at the plug end.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_plug_wall_notch_height
title: Wall notch depth
changes: Cuts the notch deeper or shallower into the plug end.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_plug_wall_notch_rounding
title: Wall notch corner rounding
changes: Rounds or squares the notch's two inner corners.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_zip_tie_hole_diameter
title: Zip-tie hole diameter
changes: Widens every zip-tie hole.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_zip_tie_height_spacing
title: Zip-tie row spacing
changes: Moves the second row of zip-tie holes closer to or farther from the first.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_zip_tie_width_spacing
title: Zip-tie column spacing
changes: Moves no zip-tie hole, because the two columns follow the pocket wall, and only feeds the auto-fit keep-out that can trim the row spacing by a hair.
note: Changes no shape of its own: the zip-tie columns sit zip_edge_offset inside the pocket wall; this dial only feeds the auto-fit finger keep-out, which trimmed the row spacing by 0.05 mm at the Custom defaults.

name: custom_zip_tie_distance_from_notch
title: Zip-tie distance from the notch
changes: Moves the first row of zip-tie holes farther from the wall notch, and the second row follows.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_zip_tie_countersink
title: Zip-tie countersink
changes: Flares the top of the zip-tie holes wider so the tie head sits flush.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_velcro_hole_length
section: Velcro / Wing Strap Holes (Custom size only)
title: Strap slot length
changes: Lengthens each plain strap slot along its lean.
note: Only acts when size is Custom and velcro_style is Classic slot.

name: custom_velcro_hole_width
section: Velcro / Wing Strap Holes (Custom size only)
title: Strap slot width
changes: Widens each plain strap slot.
note: Only acts when size is Custom and velcro_style is Classic slot.

name: custom_velcro_hole_x_center
section: Velcro / Wing Strap Holes (Custom size only)
title: Strap slot distance from the centerline
changes: Moves the two plain strap slots closer to or farther from the centerline.
note: Only acts when size is Custom and velcro_style is Classic slot.

name: custom_velcro_hole_y_center
section: Velcro / Wing Strap Holes (Custom size only)
title: Strap slot position along the body
changes: Slides the two plain strap slots toward the cord end or the plug end.
note: Only acts when size is Custom and velcro_style is Classic slot.

name: custom_velcro_hole_rotation
section: Velcro / Wing Strap Holes (Custom size only)
title: Strap slot lean
changes: Leans the two plain strap slots more or less steeply, mirrored on the two sides.
note: Only acts when size is Custom and velcro_style is Classic slot.

name: custom_body_side_rounding
title: Body side rounding
changes: Rounds the body outline's corners more or less, down to the plain octagon at 0.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_body_top_rounding
title: Top edge rounding
changes: Rounds or squares the edge where the body's top face meets its sides.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_body_bottom_rounding
title: Bottom edge rounding
changes: Rounds or squares the edge where the body's bottom face meets its sides.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_velcro_side_rounding
title: Strap slot corner rounding
changes: Rounds the four corners of each plain strap slot.
note: Only acts when size is Custom and velcro_style is Classic slot.

name: custom_velcro_top_bottom_rounding
title: Strap opening edge rounding
changes: Flares the top and bottom edges of the strap openings so the strap does not chafe.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_finger_hole_rounding
title: Finger hole rim rounding
changes: Rounds or squares the rims of both finger holes on both faces.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_t_hook_holder_side_rounding
title: Hook crossbar corner rounding
changes: Rounds or squares the top corners of the hook's crossbar.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: custom_t_hook_gap_side_rounding
title: Hook slot corner rounding
changes: Changes no shape of the printed tool, because the J-hook cord catch draws its own corners.
note: Changes no shape: the J-hook cord catch is drawn without this dial; it only appears in the Cutouts Only 2D debug overlay.

name: custom_t_hook_top_bottom_rounding
title: Hook edge rounding
changes: Flares the top and bottom edges of the cord hook's slot and crossbar.
note: Only acts when size is Custom.

name: plug_preset
title: Plug preset
changes: Fills in the plug's length, both widths and the cord from the measured heavy-duty cord plug, so the arms, the grip gap, the cord channel and the plate length all take that plug's shape at once.

name: measure_plug_length
title: Plug length
changes: Lengthens both arms so the teeth cover the whole plug body, and moves the zip-tie stations and the strap slot with them.

name: measure_plug_width_prong_end
title: Plug width at the prong end
changes: Opens or closes the gap between the arms at their tips, where the plug's prong end sits.

name: measure_plug_width_cord_end
title: Plug width at the cord end
changes: Opens or closes the gap between the arms at the plug's back end, so the arms taper to match the plug.

name: measure_cord_thickness
title: Cord thickness
changes: Widens the cord channel between the finger holes, and the finger lobes move outward with it.

name: plug_sides
title: Plug sides
changes: Removes the sloped cradle from the arms' gripping edges so the teeth bite straight along a flat-sided plug.

name: show_plug_preview
title: Show the see-through plug
changes: Shows or hides the see-through plug in the preview and changes nothing in the printed plates.
note: Changes no shape: the see-through plug is a preview aid and is never exported.

name: size
title: Hand size
changes: Widens both finger holes and their lobes, so the whole plate grows around them.

name: measure_finger_width
title: Finger width
changes: Widens both finger holes and their lobes.
note: Only acts when size is Measure my hand.

name: attachment
title: Attachment
changes: Removes the strap slot from each arm, while the zip-tie stations stay because they hold the plates together.
note: Drawn on a 40 mm plug: on the default 25.5 mm plug the arms are too short for a strap slot.

name: strap_width
title: Strap width
changes: Sets the strap the arm slot must clear, and when the slot's window between the zip-tie stations is shorter than the strap plus 1.5 mm the slot is left out.
note: Drawn on a 40 mm plug: on the default 25.5 mm plug the arms are too short for a strap slot.

name: print_layout
title: Print layout
changes: Puts both identical plates side by side in one file, or just one plate.

name: plate_wall_boost
title: Extra wall on the plate
changes: Thickens every wall around the finger holes, the cord channel, the zip-tie holes and the strap slot at once, so the plate outline grows and the openings shift to keep their walls.

name: plate_thickness
title: Plate thickness
changes: Thickens each plate, so the finished pair is twice as thick.

name: plate_grip_bite
title: Grip bite
changes: Squeezes the plug harder or softer, because the arms close in by this much per side against the plug's width.
note: Only acts when plug_sides is Flat sides or a plug preset is chosen.

name: plate_cradle_depth
title: Cradle depth
changes: Slopes each arm's gripping edge from the mating face down to the outer face, so two plates form a cradle that centers a round plug.
note: Only acts when plug_sides is Rounded sides.

name: plate_grip_clearance
title: Grip clearance
changes: Opens the gap between the arms where the plates meet, so a hard round plug can drop in flat before the cradle holds it.
note: Only acts when plug_sides is Rounded sides.

name: plate_cable_clearance
title: Cord channel clearance
changes: Widens the cord channel between the finger holes beyond the cord's thickness.

name: plate_finger_fit
title: Finger hole fit
changes: Widens both finger holes beyond your finger width.

name: plate_finger_wall
title: Finger lobe wall
changes: Thickens the wall around each finger hole, so the rounded lobes grow.

name: plate_finger_inner_wall
title: Wall beside the cord channel
changes: Thickens the wall between the cord channel and each finger hole, pushing the finger holes outward.

name: plate_tooth_diameter
title: Tooth size
changes: Cuts bigger or smaller scallops into the arms' gripping edges.

name: plate_tooth_pitch
title: Tooth spacing
changes: Spaces the teeth farther apart or closer together along the gripping edges.

name: plate_tooth_depth
title: Tooth depth
changes: Cuts each tooth deeper or shallower into the gripping edge.

name: plate_grip_zone_start
title: Toothed zone start
changes: Moves where the teeth begin, measured back from the arm tips, and the arms lengthen when the zone needs the room.

name: plate_grip_zone_length
title: Toothed zone length
changes: Sets how far the teeth run along each arm instead of covering the whole plug body.

name: plate_tip_flare
title: Tip flare
changes: Opens the gap wider right at the arm tips so the plug head can enter before the teeth bite.

name: plate_arm_tip_width
title: Arm tip width
changes: Widens the rounded tip of each arm, so the arms taper less.

name: plate_edge_rounding
title: Outer edge rounding
changes: Rounds or squares the outer face's edge all around the plate, while the plug-contact face stays square.

name: plate_strip_thickness
title: Cable strip thickness
changes: Thickens or removes the thin strip that bridges the cord channel on the outer face and ties the two arms together.

name: plate_zip_hole_diameter
title: Zip-tie hole diameter
changes: Widens the three zip-tie holes in each arm, and the stations shift to keep their walls.

name: plate_zip_placement
title: Zip-tie station placement
changes: Switches the three zip-tie stations in each arm from the automatic positions to the three position dials.
note: Drawn on a 40 mm plug so the default manual positions sit on the arm.

name: plate_zip_pos_1
title: Zip-tie station 1 position
changes: Slides the rear zip-tie station along each arm, measured from the cord end.
note: Only acts when plate_zip_placement is Manual; drawn on a 40 mm plug so every station sits on the arm.

name: plate_zip_pos_2
title: Zip-tie station 2 position
changes: Slides the middle zip-tie station along each arm, and the strap slot's window moves with it.
note: Only acts when plate_zip_placement is Manual; drawn on a 40 mm plug so every station sits on the arm.

name: plate_zip_pos_3
title: Zip-tie station 3 position
changes: Slides the tip zip-tie station along each arm, and the strap slot's window moves with it.
note: Only acts when plate_zip_placement is Manual; drawn on a 40 mm plug so every station sits on the arm.

name: plate_slot_inner_wall
title: Wall between the teeth and the slot
changes: Thickens the wall between the toothed edge and the strap slot, moving the slot outward.
note: Drawn on a 40 mm plug: on the default 25.5 mm plug the arms are too short for a strap slot.

name: plate_velcro_slot_width
title: Strap slot width
changes: Widens the strap slot in each arm, and the arm bulges outward to keep its wall.
note: Drawn on a 40 mm plug: on the default 25.5 mm plug the arms are too short for a strap slot.

name: plate_velcro_slot_length
title: Strap slot length
changes: Lengthens or shortens the strap slot along each arm, within the window between the zip-tie stations.
note: Drawn on a 40 mm plug: on the default 25.5 mm plug the arms are too short for a strap slot.

name: quality
title: Render quality
changes: Sets how many flat segments draw each curve and changes no dimension.
note: Changes no shape: it only sets the number of segments in every circle and arc.
